intent.goal: Make run_report.py's WIP-curve check require one complete row per recorded dispatch wave — wave=<k> + builders=<n> reviewers=<n> + every protocol metric — and make attention-budget.md name that exact schema so the text and the check cannot drift again.
intent.ruled_out: Declaring the recorded waves by counting the rows themselves (a single row for a multi-wave run is undetectable without an independent count) or by prose 'wave N' mentions (fuzzy); refusing every table row that carries builders=/reviewers= (an unrelated deviation row would refuse a report with complete rows); a worked example block in the protocol doc (activation-load budget — the doc may grow only ~27 bytes before a mission's rounded load badge moves); editing the historical 2026-08-28 ship-it report; changing WIP caps, graduation analysis, or the manifest/inventory/invocation checks.
intent.why: The report's RUN: header is already its single machine-parsed identity line, so `waves=<n>` there is the one place a report records how many waves it ran; rows are identified by `wave=<k>` so settings-only and unrelated rows are simply not data points; digit-led metric values refuse placeholders (`?`, `TBD`, `<n>`, 'not measured to protocol') without fixing units.
